# Zephra

> Zephra is a native macOS app for local AI image and short-video generation on Apple Silicon, powered by MLX and Metal.

The official website is https://zephra.urandom.io/. Zephra supports image generation and editing with Z-Image-Turbo, Qwen-Image-2512, and FLUX.2 klein 4B; video generation and image animation with LTX-2.5; and still-image upscaling with Real-ESRGAN. Video clips currently have no audio. macOS 15 or later and Apple Silicon are required. Model downloads need an internet connection; generation runs locally after models are prepared.
